title: Handover UI
description: ui.json in a frozen handover (handovers/<id>/), present only when a screen spec is bound to an in-scope UI element. Written by Core.handoverPlan at freeze, listed and hashed in handover.yaml (named there as `ui:`, with `ui_screens:`), outside the handover id (the files it names are inside it). The spec, the template and the components each screen places are copied as text under ui/specs/ and ui/pack/; the approved preview pictures are copied under ui/previews/<screen>/. The holdout sample and holdout acceptance cases are NEVER copied: only their sha256 is here, so a consumer can name them and the Factory can judge them. designc owns this contract; consumers conform to it. docs/handover-ui.example.json is the shared fixture.

pack.description: The pinned UI pack the copies come from (ledger ui_pinned); null when no pin is recorded.

screens.description: One entry per bound screen in scope, ordered by spec path.

components.description: The library components the spec places, ordered by name. Each is a copy of the pack's manifest.

approved_ts.description: Ledger time of the approval; null when it carries none.

files.description: Path under ui/previews/<screen>/ (placements included) to the sha256 of the picture. The pictures are in the handover at handovers/<id>/ui/previews/<screen>/<path>.

holdout.description: The holdout sample for the screen (ui/holdout/<screen>.json in the registry): hash only, never copied. null when the screen has none.

holdout_cases.description: Acceptance cases marked holdout on this screen's component: left out of the acceptance copies and the generated specs, named by the sha256 of the case's canonical JSON (keys sorted).

case.description: Index in the criterion's cases list in the registry.
